```{r}
#| include: false
library(targets)
d <- tar_read(dashboard_data)
ojs_define(
  ranks_raw = d$ranks, games_raw = d$games, snaps_raw = d$snaps, teams_raw = d$teams,
  bt_overall = d$backtest$overall, bt_season = d$backtest$by_season, bt_cal = d$backtest$calibration,
  cfg = d$config
)
sim <- tar_read(season_sim)
ojs_define(
  sim_teams = sim$teams, sim_records = sim$records, sim_paths = sim$paths, sim_root = sim$root,
  sim_seeds = sim$seeds, sim_meta = sim$meta
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Team logo, with CFBD's dark-background version swapped in by CSS under the dark theme
logoImg = (id, size) => {
  const t = TEAMS.get(id)
  if (!t?.logo) return ""
  const dim = size ? { width: size, height: size } : {}
  return t.logo_dark
    ? htl.html`<img class="logo-light" src=${t.logo} alt="" loading="lazy" ${dim}><img class="logo-dark" src=${t.logo_dark} alt="" loading="lazy" ${dim}>`
    : htl.html`<img src=${t.logo} alt="" loading="lazy" ${dim}>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
ibar = (v, lo, hi, [min, max], color, w = 120) => {
  const x = d3.scaleLinear([min, max], [6, w - 6]).clamp(true)
  return htl.svg`<svg class="ibar" width=${w} height=16>
    ${min < 0 && max > 0 ? htl.svg`<line class="zero" x1=${x(0)} x2=${x(0)} y1=2 y2=14></line>` : ""}
    <line class="rng" x1=${x(lo)} x2=${x(hi)} y1=8 y2=8 stroke=${color}></line>
    <circle cx=${x(v)} cy=8 r=4.5 fill=${color}></circle></svg>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
move = (now, before) => {
  if (before == null || now == null) return htl.html`<span class="move flat">new</span>`
  const d = before - now
  if (d === 0) return htl.html`<span class="move flat">–</span>`
  return d > 0 ? htl.html`<span class="move up" title="Up ${d}">▲${d}</span>`
               : htl.html`<span class="move down" title="Down ${-d}">▼${-d}</span>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// ---- conference filter: "all", "grp:<group>", or "conf:<conference>" ----------------
grpName = g => g === "Power" ? (season < 2024 ? "Power 5" : "Power 4")
  : g === "Group" ? (season < 2026 ? "Group of 5" : "Group of 6")
  : g === "Independent" ? "Independents" : g
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
confKeys = rows => {
  const groups = ["Power", "Group", "Independent", "FCS"].filter(g => rows.some(d => d.grp === g))
  const confs = [...new Set(rows.map(d => d.conf))].filter(c => c !== "FBS Independents").sort()
  return ["all", ...groups.map(g => "grp:" + g), ...confs.map(c => "conf:" + c)]
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
confFmt = k => k === "all" ? "All teams" : k.startsWith("grp:") ? `— ${grpName(k.slice(4))} —` : k.slice(5)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
inConf = (d, k) => k === "all" || (k.startsWith("grp:") ? d.grp === k.slice(4) : d.conf === k.slice(5))
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
confKeyOf = d => d.grp === "Independent" ? "grp:Independent" : "conf:" + d.conf
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Picker for a team within a conference filter; keeps `preferred` when it is in the list
teamPicker = (rows, key, label, preferred) => {
  const opts = rows.filter(d => inConf(d, key)).sort((a, b) => a.team.localeCompare(b.team))
  const best = [...opts].sort((a, b) => a.prk - b.prk)
  const value = opts.some(d => d.id === preferred) ? preferred : best[0]?.id
  return Inputs.select(opts.map(d => d.id), { label, format: id => opts.find(d => d.id === id).team, value })
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Greedy label placement for scatter plots: each label tries above, below, right, then left of
// its dot and takes the first spot that doesn't overlap a label already placed. Positions are
// estimated from the data extents and the plot's approximate size (w x h pixels).
// Returns [[rows, {dx, dy, textAnchor}], ...], one Plot.text mark per placement.
placeLabels = (rows, xk, yk, all, w, h) => {
  const [x0, x1] = d3.extent(all, d => d[xk]), [y0, y1] = d3.extent(all, d => d[yk])
  const px = d => ((d[xk] - x0) / (x1 - x0 || 1)) * w, py = d => h - ((d[yk] - y0) / (y1 - y0 || 1)) * h
  const spots = [{ dx: 0, dy: -10, textAnchor: "middle" }, { dx: 0, dy: 13, textAnchor: "middle" },
                 { dx: 8, dy: 0, textAnchor: "start" }, { dx: -8, dy: 0, textAnchor: "end" }]
  const box = (d, o) => {
    const tw = 6.3 * d.team.length, x = px(d) + o.dx, y = py(d) + o.dy
    const left = o.textAnchor === "middle" ? x - tw / 2 : o.textAnchor === "start" ? x : x - tw
    return [left, y - 7, left + tw, y + 7]
  }
  const hit = (a, b) => a[0] < b[2] && b[0] < a[2] && a[1] < b[3] && b[1] < a[3]
  const placed = [], groups = spots.map(() => [])
  for (const d of [...rows].sort((a, b) => b[yk] - a[yk])) {
    let k = spots.findIndex(o => !placed.some(p => hit(p, box(d, o))))
    if (k < 0) k = 0
    placed.push(box(d, spots[k])); groups[k].push(d)
  }
  return spots.map((o, k) => [groups[k], o]).filter(([g]) => g.length)
}
```

```{ojs}
// Normal CDF (Abramowitz–Stegun) for matchup win probability
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
normCdf = z => { const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(z)); const d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp(-z * z / 2);
  const p = d * t * (0.3193815 + t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
  return z > 0 ? 1 - p : p }
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// Points an average FBS team scores against another (off + def of a team = 2 x this + its total tendency)
avgPts = d3.mean(fbs, d => (d.off + d.def) / 2)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Projected score "31–24" for a team and its opponent (null when either is missing)
fmtScore = (pts, opp) => pts == null || opp == null ? null : `${Math.round(pts)}–${Math.round(opp)}`
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mTeams = {
  const last = d3.max(seasonSnaps, d => d.w)
  const fcs = R.filter(d => d.s === season && d.w === last && d.tier === 2)
  return [...fbs, ...fcs].sort((a, b) => a.team.localeCompare(b.team))
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
matchup = {
  const a = mTeams.find(d => d.id === teamA), b = mTeams.find(d => d.id === teamB)
  const v = venue === "Neutral" ? 0 : venue === "A at home" ? 1 : -1
  const mean = a.pw - b.pw + snap.hfa * v
  // Normal approximation: game noise (growing with the spread for the scale-t family) plus
  // the uncertainty in both ratings
  const sd = Math.sqrt(snap.noise_sd ** 2 + (snap.noise_slope * mean) ** 2 + a.pw_sd ** 2 + b.pw_sd ** 2)
  const hasScore = a.off != null && b.off != null
  const ptsA = hasScore ? a.off + b.def - avgPts + snap.hfa * v / 2 : null
  const ptsB = hasScore ? b.off + a.def - avgPts - snap.hfa * v / 2 : null
  return { a, b, mean, sd, pA: normCdf(mean / sd), ptsA, ptsB }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// Simulated teams with their group and current ranks from the snapshot the simulation used
simRows = {
  const now = new Map(R.filter(d => d.s === sim_meta.season && d.w === sim_meta.week && d.tier === 1).map(d => [d.id, d]))
  const seeds = d3.group(SIMSEED, d => d.id)
  return rows0(sim_teams).map(d => {
    const s = seeds.get(d.id) ?? []
    const xseed = d.p_cfp > 0 ? d3.sum(s, x => x.seed * x.p) / d.p_cfp : null
    return { ...d, grp: now.get(d.id)?.grp ?? "Group", prk: now.get(d.id)?.prk, rrk_now: now.get(d.id)?.rrk,
             seeds: new Map(s.map(x => [x.seed, x.p])), xseed }
  })
}
```

## Row {.flow}

```{ojs}
{
  const tile = (cls, label, row, value, sub) => htl.html`<div class=${"tile " + cls}>
    <div class="label">${label}</div>
    <div class="value">${logoImg(row.id, 26)}${row.team}</div>
    <div class="sub">${value} · ${sub}</div></div>`
  const byP = [...fbs].sort((a, b) => a.prk - b.prk)
  const byR = hasResume ? [...fbs].sort((a, b) => a.rrk - b.rrk) : byP
  const r1 = byR[0], p1 = byP[0], bubble = byR[cfg.benchmark_rank - 1]
  if (!hasResume) return htl.html`<div class="tiles">${tile("power", "#1 Power (preseason)", p1, `${fmtSigned(p1.pw)} pts`, "last season's rating, regressed")}
    <div class="tile"><div class="label">Resume</div><div class="value">No games yet</div><div class="sub">Pick a later week</div></div></div>`
  return htl.html`<div class="tiles">
    ${tile("resume", "#1 Resume", r1, `${fmtSigned(r1.wab, 2)} WAB`, `${r1.wins}–${r1.losses}`)}
    ${tile("power", "#1 Power", p1, `${fmtSigned(p1.pw)} pts`, `${p1.wins}–${p1.losses}`)}
    ${tile("resume", `Bubble · #${cfg.benchmark_rank} Resume`, bubble, `${fmtSigned(bubble.wab, 2)} WAB`, `${bubble.wins}–${bubble.losses}`)}
    <div class="tile"><div class="label">Biggest gap</div>${(() => {
      const g = [...fbs].filter(d => d.rrk <= 25 || d.prk <= 25).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.rrk - b.prk) - Math.abs(a.rrk - a.prk))[0]
      return htl.html`<div class="value">${logoImg(g.id, 26)}${g.team}</div>
        <div class="sub">Resume #${g.rrk} · Power #${g.prk}</div>`})()}</div>
  </div>`
}
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "FBS rankings"
{
  const key = sortBy === "Resume" && hasResume ? "rrk" : "prk"
  const rows = fbs
    .filter(d => inConf(d, confPick))
    .filter(d => !search || d.team.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
    .sort((a, b) => a[key] - b[key])
  const wabDom = d3.extent(fbs.flatMap(d => [d.wab_lo, d.wab_hi]))
  const pwDom = d3.extent(fbs.flatMap(d => [d.pw_lo, d.pw_hi]))
  const tr = d => htl.html`<tr class="clickable" onclick=${() => goToTeam(d.id)}>
    <td class="rank num">${d[key]}<div class="xs-only move-xs">${move(d[key], prevRows.get(d.id)?.[key])}</div></td>
    <td class="hide-xs">${move(d[key], prevRows.get(d.id)?.[key])}</td>
    <td class="team">${teamCell(d.id, d.team, d.conf, `${d.wins}–${d.losses}`)}</td>
    <td class="num hide-xs">${d.wins}–${d.losses}</td>
    <td class="num"><strong>${fmtSigned(d.wab, 2)}</strong></td>
    <td class="hide-sm">${ibar(d.wab, d.wab_lo, d.wab_hi, wabDom, hue.resume, 90)}</td>
    <td class="num">${d.rrk}${d.rrk_lo == null ? "" : htl.html`<span class="muted iv" style="font-size:0.75rem"> (${d.rrk_lo}–${d.rrk_hi})</span>`}</td>
    <td class="num hide-sm">${fmtPct(d.p12)}</td>
    <td class="num"><strong>${fmtSigned(d.pw)}</strong></td>
    <td class="hide-sm">${ibar(d.pw, d.pw_lo, d.pw_hi, pwDom, hue.power, 90)}</td>
    <td class="num">${d.prk}<span class="muted iv" style="font-size:0.75rem"> (${d.prk_lo}–${d.prk_hi})</span></td>
    <td class="num hide-sm" title=${d.off == null ? "" : `Offence #${d.off_rk}: ${d.off.toFixed(1)} pts scored vs. an average FBS defence\nDefence #${d.def_rk}: ${d.def.toFixed(1)} pts allowed vs. an average FBS offence`}>${d.off == null ? "–" : `${d.off_rk} / ${d.def_rk}`}</td>
    <td class="num hide-sm">${d.sos_rk ?? "–"}</td>
    <td class="num hide-sm">${fmtSigned(d.luck)}</td>
    <td class="num hide-sm">${d.colley ?? "–"}</td>
    <td class="num">${rankOrNR(d.ap)}</td>
    <td class="num" title="CBS Sports 138 (ranks every FBS team)">${rankOrNR(d.cbs)}</td>
    <td class="num">${rankOrNR(d.cfp)}</td>
  </tr>`
  return htl.html`<div class="table-wrap"><table class="cfb-table">
    <thead>
      <tr class="group"><th colspan=4></th><th colspan=4 class="resume">Resume</th><th colspan=4 class="power">Power</th><th colspan=3 class="hide-sm"></th><th colspan=3>Polls</th></tr>
      <tr><th class="num rank">#</th><th class="hide-xs"></th><th class="team">Team</th><th class="num hide-xs">Record</th>
        <th class="num" title="Wins above the #${cfg.benchmark_rank} team vs. this schedule">WAB</th><th class="hide-sm" title="80% interval">80%</th><th class="num" title="Median rank (80% interval)">Rank<span class="xs-only"> (res.)</span></th><th class="num hide-sm" title="Probability of a top-12 resume">Top 12</th>
        <th class="num" title="Points vs. average FBS team, neutral field">Rating</th><th class="hide-sm" title="80% interval">80%</th><th class="num">Rank<span class="xs-only"> (pow.)</span></th>
        <th class="num hide-sm" title="Offence rank / defence rank (hover a cell for points)">Off / Def</th>
        <th class="num hide-sm" title="Schedule strength rank (benchmark's expected loss rate)">SOS</th><th class="num hide-sm" title="Wins minus expected wins">Luck</th><th class="num hide-sm" title="Colley matrix (record only)">Colley</th>
        <th class="num">AP</th><th class="num" title="CBS Sports 138">CBS</th><th class="num">CFP</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>${rows.map(tr)}</tbody></table></div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const future = tGames.filter(g => g.result == null && g.wk > snap.w)
  const played = tGames.filter(g => g.result != null && g.wk <= snap.w)
  const xFinal = tRow.wins + d3.sum(future, g => g.fut_wp ?? 0)
  const fact = (label, v, color) => htl.html`<div class="fact"><div class="small-caps">${label}</div><div class="v" style=${color ? { color } : {}}>${v}</div></div>`
  return htl.html`<div class="team-header">
    ${logoImg(tRow.id)}
    <div><h2>${tRow.team}</h2><div class="muted">${tRow.conf} · ${tRow.wins}–${tRow.losses} through ${snap.label}</div></div>
    <div class="facts">
      ${fact("Resume", tRow.rrk == null ? "–" : `#${tRow.rrk}`, "var(--resume)")}
      ${fact("WAB", fmtSigned(tRow.wab, 2))}
      ${fact("Power", `#${tRow.prk}`, "var(--power)")}
      ${fact("Rating", `${fmtSigned(tRow.pw)}`)}
      ${tRow.off == null ? "" : fact("Offence", `#${tRow.off_rk} · ${tRow.off.toFixed(1)}`)}
      ${tRow.def == null ? "" : fact("Defence", `#${tRow.def_rk} · ${tRow.def.toFixed(1)}`)}
      ${fact("AP", tRow.ap ?? "–")}
      ${fact("CBS", tRow.cbs ?? "–")}
      ${fact("Luck", fmtSigned(tRow.luck))}
      ${future.length ? fact("Proj. record", `${xFinal.toFixed(1)}–${(tRow.wins + tRow.losses + future.length - xFinal).toFixed(1)}`) : ""}
    </div></div>`
}
```

## Row

### Column {width="66%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Schedule"
{
  const rows = tGames.filter(g => g.wk <= snap.w || g.result == null)
  // betting convention: the team's spread, negative when favoured
  const spread = m => m == null ? "–" : Math.abs(m) < 0.05 ? "PK" : fmtSigned(-m)
  const wpOf = g => g.result == null ? g.fut_wp : g.pre_wp
  const withWp = rows.filter(g => wpOf(g) != null)
  const xw = d3.sum(withWp, wpOf), n = withWp.length
  const playedRows = rows.filter(g => g.result != null)
  const actualW = playedRows.filter(g => g.result === "W").length
  const futureRows = rows.filter(g => g.result == null)
  const projW = actualW + d3.sum(futureRows, g => g.fut_wp ?? 0)
  const tr = g => {
    const isFuture = g.result == null
    const wp = isFuture ? g.fut_wp : g.pre_wp
    const opp = R.find(d => d.s === season && d.w === snap.w && d.id === g.opp_id)
    return htl.html`<tr>
      <td class="muted">${g.label === "Postseason" ? "Post" : g.label.replace("Week ", "")}</td>
      <td class="team">${teamCell(g.opp_id, `${g.venue === "A" ? "@ " : g.venue === "N" ? "vs " : ""}${g.opp}`, opp ? htl.html`<span class="hide-xs">Resume #${opp.rrk} · Power #${opp.prk}</span><span class="xs-only">Res. #${opp.rrk} · Pow. #${opp.prk}</span>` : "")}</td>
      <td>${isFuture ? htl.html`<span class="muted">${new Date(g.date + "T12:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}</span>` :
        htl.html`<span class=${g.result === "W" ? "result-w" : "result-l"}>${g.result}</span> <span class="num">${g.pts}–${g.opp_pts}${g.ot ? " OT" : ""}</span>`}</td>
      <td class="num" title=${isFuture ? "Expected result and win probability now" : "Expected result and pre-game win probability (model as of the previous week)"}>${wp == null ? "–" : htl.html`<span class="muted" style="font-weight:600">${wp >= 0.5 ? "W" : "L"}</span> ${fmtPct(wp)}`}</td>
      <td class="num" title=${isFuture ? "Model spread now" : "Model spread before kickoff"}>${spread(isFuture ? g.fut_margin : g.pre_margin)}</td>
      <td class="num hide-sm" title=${isFuture ? "Projected score now" : "Projected score before kickoff"}>${(isFuture ? fmtScore(g.fut_pts, g.fut_opp_pts) : fmtScore(g.pre_pts, g.pre_opp_pts)) ?? "–"}</td>
      <td class="num hide-sm">${spread(g.line)}</td>
      <td class="num" title="Resume contribution: result minus the benchmark's win probability">${g.wab_game == null ? "–" : htl.html`<strong style=${{ color: g.wab_game >= 0 ? "var(--up)" : "var(--down)" }}>${fmtSigned(g.wab_game, 2)}</strong>`}</td>
    </tr>`
  }
  return htl.html`<div class="table-wrap"><table class="cfb-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Wk</th><th class="team">Opponent</th><th>Result</th><th class="num" title="Model's expected result and win probability">Expected</th><th class="num" title="Model spread for this team (negative = favoured)">Model</th><th class="num hide-sm" title="Projected score: this team first">Proj.</th><th class="num hide-sm" title="Closing-line spread for this team (negative = favoured)">Vegas</th><th class="num" title="Resume contribution (wins above benchmark)">WAB</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${rows.map(tr)}</tbody>
    <tfoot><tr><td colspan=8 style="padding-top:10px; white-space:normal">
      <span class="small-caps">Expected record</span> <strong class="num">${xw.toFixed(1)}–${(n - xw).toFixed(1)}</strong>
      <span class="muted">(sum of win probabilities: pre-game for played games, current for the rest)</span>
      ${futureRows.length ? htl.html` · <span class="small-caps">Projected final</span> <strong class="num">${projW.toFixed(1)}–${(playedRows.length + futureRows.length - projW).toFixed(1)}</strong>
      <span class="muted">(actual ${actualW}–${playedRows.length - actualW} + expected)</span>` : ""}
    </td></tr></tfoot></table></div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
  const long = hist.flatMap(d => [{ w: d.w, rank: d.rrk, what: "Resume" }, { w: d.w, rank: d.prk, what: "Power" }])

      Plot.tip(long, Plot.pointer({ x: "w", y: "rank", title: d => `${d.what} rank #${d.rank} (${labels.get(d.w)})` }))
    ]
  })
}
```

## Row {height="100%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Prediction"
{
  const { a, b, mean, pA, ptsA, ptsB } = matchup
  const fav = mean >= 0 ? a : b
  const rk = (v, r, d = 1) => v == null ? "–" : htl.html`${typeof v === "number" ? v.toFixed(d) : v} <span class="muted" style="font-size:0.75rem">#${r ?? "–"}</span>`
  const row = (label, fa, fb, title) => htl.html`<tr title=${title ?? ""}><td>${label}</td><td class="num">${fa}</td><td class="num">${fb}</td></tr>`
  return htl.html`<div class="tiles">
    <div class="tile power"><div class="label">Predicted spread</div>
      <div class="value">${logoImg(fav.id, 26)}${fav.team} by ${Math.abs(mean).toFixed(1)}</div>
      <div class="sub">${venue === "Neutral" ? "Neutral site" : `Incl. home field ${snap.hfa.toFixed(1)}`}</div></div>
    <div class="tile"><div class="label">${a.team} win probability</div><div class="value">${fmtPct(pA)}</div>
      <div class="sub">${b.team}: ${fmtPct(1 - pA)}</div></div>
    ${ptsA == null ? "" : htl.html`<div class="tile"><div class="label">Projected score</div>
      <div class="value">${Math.round(ptsA)}–${Math.round(ptsB)}</div>
      <div class="sub">Total ${(ptsA + ptsB).toFixed(1)}</div></div>`}
  </div>
  <table class="cfb-table" style="margin-top:14px">
    <thead><tr><th></th><th class="num">${a.team}</th><th class="num">${b.team}</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      ${row("Power", rk(fmtSigned(a.pw), a.prk), rk(fmtSigned(b.pw), b.prk), "Points vs. an average FBS team (rank)")}
      ${a.off == null ? "" : row("Offence", rk(a.off, a.off_rk), rk(b.off, b.off_rk), "Points scored vs. an average FBS defence (rank)")}
      ${a.def == null ? "" : row("Defence", rk(a.def, a.def_rk), rk(b.def, b.def_rk), "Points allowed vs. an average FBS offence (rank)")}
      ${row("Resume", a.rrk == null ? "–" : `#${a.rrk}`, b.rrk == null ? "–" : `#${b.rrk}`)}
      ${row("Record", `${a.wins}–${a.losses}`, `${b.wins}–${b.losses}`)}
    </tbody></table>
  <p class="explain" style="margin-top:12px">The margin distribution combines game-to-game noise with uncertainty in both ratings.
  Shaded: outcomes where <strong>${a.team}</strong> wins.</p>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Margin distribution (Team A − Team B)"
{
  const { a, mean, sd } = matchup
  const xs = d3.range(mean - 3.5 * sd, mean + 3.5 * sd, sd / 40).map(x => ({ x, y: Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mean) / sd) ** 2) / (sd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) }))
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 470, x: { label: `${a.team} margin (points)` }, y: { axis: null, domain: [0, d3.max(xs, d => d.y) * 1.12] },
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(xs.filter(d => d.x >= 0), { x: "x", y: "y", fill: hue.power, fillOpacity: 0.35 }),
      Plot.line(xs, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: hue.power, strokeWidth: 2 }),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.5 }),
      Plot.ruleX([mean], { stroke: hue.power, strokeDasharray: "4,3" }),
      Plot.text([mean], { x: d => d, frameAnchor: "top", dy: 4, text: d => `mean ${fmtSigned(d)}`, fill: "currentColor" })
    ]
  })
}
```

## Row {height="100%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Model vs. Vegas"
{
  // one row per game, from the home (or first-listed) FBS side
  const rows = d3.groups(G.filter(d => d.s === season && d.wk === gamesWeek), d => d.game_id)
    .map(([, sides]) => sides.find(d => d.venue === "H") ?? sides.sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)[0])
  const info = id => R.find(d => d.s === season && d.w === snap.w && d.id === id)
  const played = rows.filter(g => g.result != null)
  const upcoming = gamesWeek > d3.max(S.filter(d => d.s === season), d => d.w)
  // margin/wp from this team's side: before kickoff for weeks already modelled, else latest snapshot
  const m = g => g.pre_margin ?? g.fut_margin, wp = g => g.pre_wp ?? g.fut_wp
  const proj = g => g.pre_margin != null ? [g.pre_pts, g.pre_opp_pts] : [g.fut_pts, g.fut_opp_pts]
  const shown = rows.filter(g => {
    const a = info(g.id), b = info(g.opp_id)
    return (a && inConf(a, gamesConf)) || (b && inConf(b, gamesConf))
  }).sort((a, b) => (a.date).localeCompare(b.date) || Math.abs(m(a) ?? 99) - Math.abs(m(b) ?? 99))
  // Short names (CFBD abbreviations) where a team is named inside a number column
  const short = (id, name) => TEAMS.get(id)?.abbr ?? name
  const fav = (g, x) => x == null ? htl.html`<span class="muted">–</span>`
    : htl.html`<span title=${x >= 0 ? g.team : g.opp}>${x >= 0 ? short(g.id, g.team) : short(g.opp_id, g.opp)}</span> <strong class="num">−${Math.abs(x).toFixed(1)}</strong>`
  // Model vs. Vegas on games with a pre-game prediction, a closing line and its win probability:
  // MAE of the margin and Brier score of the win probability (lower is better for both)
  const vsVegas = gs => {
    const r = gs.filter(g => g.result != null && m(g) != null && wp(g) != null && g.line != null && g.line_wp != null)
    const mae = f => d3.mean(r, g => Math.abs(f(g) - (g.pts - g.opp_pts)))
    const brier = f => d3.mean(r, g => (f(g) - (g.pts > g.opp_pts ? 1 : 0)) ** 2)
    return { n: r.length, mae: mae(m), maeV: mae(g => g.line), brier: brier(wp), brierV: brier(g => g.line_wp) }
  }
  const wkStats = vsVegas(played)
  const seasonStats = vsVegas(d3.groups(G.filter(d => d.s === season && d.wk <= gamesWeek), d => d.game_id).map(([, s]) => s[0]))
  const statLine = (lab, x) => htl.html`${lab}: MAE model <strong>${x.mae.toFixed(1)}</strong> vs Vegas <strong>${x.maeV.toFixed(1)}</strong>,
    Brier model <strong>${x.brier.toFixed(3)}</strong> vs Vegas <strong>${x.brierV.toFixed(3)}</strong> (${x.n} games).`
  const tr = g => {
    const mm = m(g), actual = g.result == null ? null : g.pts - g.opp_pts
    const edge = mm != null && g.line != null ? mm - g.line : null
    const closer = actual == null || mm == null || g.line == null ? null
      : Math.abs(mm - actual) < Math.abs(g.line - actual) ? "Model" : Math.abs(mm - actual) > Math.abs(g.line - actual) ? "Vegas" : "Tie"
    const p = wp(g)
    return htl.html`<tr>
      <td class="team">${teamCell(g.id, g.team, info(g.id) ? htl.html`<span title=${info(g.id).conf}><span class="conf-wide">${info(g.id).conf} · </span><span class="hide-xs">Power</span><span class="xs-only">Pow.</span> #${info(g.id).prk}</span>` : "")}</td>
      <td class="muted" title=${g.venue === "N" ? "Neutral site" : `Home: ${g.team}`}>${g.venue === "N" ? "vs" : "hosts"}</td>
      <td class="team">${teamCell(g.opp_id, g.opp, info(g.opp_id) ? htl.html`<span title=${info(g.opp_id).conf}><span class="conf-wide">${info(g.opp_id).conf} · </span><span class="hide-xs">Power</span><span class="xs-only">Pow.</span> #${info(g.opp_id).prk}</span>` : "")}</td>
      <td>${fav(g, mm)}</td>
      <td>${p == null ? "–" : pbar(Math.max(p, 1 - p), hue.power)}</td>
      <td class="num hide-sm" title="Projected score (team first) and total">${(() => { const [p, o] = proj(g); return p == null ? "–" : htl.html`${Math.round(p)}–${Math.round(o)}<div class="muted" style="font-size:0.75rem">total ${(p + o).toFixed(0)}</div>` })()}</td>
      <td class="hide-sm">${fav(g, g.line)}${g.ou == null ? "" : htl.html`<div class="muted" style="font-size:0.75rem">O/U ${g.ou}</div>`}</td>
      <td class="num hide-sm" title="Model margin minus Vegas margin, for ${g.team}">${edge == null ? "–" : htl.html`<span title=${`Model likes ${edge >= 0 ? g.team : g.opp} by ${Math.abs(edge).toFixed(1)} more than Vegas`}>${Math.abs(edge) < 0.05 ? "0.0" : `${edge >= 0 ? short(g.id, g.team) : short(g.opp_id, g.opp)} +${Math.abs(edge).toFixed(1)}`}</span>`}</td>
      <td>${g.result == null ? htl.html`<span class="muted">${g.date}</span>` : htl.html`<span class="num" title=${g.team}>${short(g.id, g.team)} ${g.pts}–${g.opp_pts}${g.ot ? " OT" : ""}</span>`}</td>
      <td>${closer == null ? "" : htl.html`<span class=${closer === "Model" ? "result-w" : closer === "Vegas" ? "result-l" : "muted"}>${closer}</span>`}</td>
    </tr>`
  }
  return htl.html`<p class="explain">Spreads are the <strong>model's predicted margin</strong> from the snapshot before kickoff
  (${upcoming ? "latest snapshot" : "previous week's snapshot"}) next to the closing line. Favourite shown with its spread.
  ${wkStats.n ? statLine("This week so far", wkStats) : ""}
  ${seasonStats.n ? statLine(`Season through this week`, seasonStats) : ""}
  ${wkStats.n || seasonStats.n ? "Lower is better for both." : ""}</p>
  <div class="table-wrap"><table class="cfb-table">
    <thead><tr><th class="team">Team</th><th></th><th class="team">Opponent</th><th>Model spread</th><th>Fav. win prob.</th><th class="num hide-sm" title="Projected score (team first) and total">Proj.</th><th class="hide-sm" title="Closing line and over/under">Vegas</th><th class="hide-sm" title="Where the model differs from the closing line">Edge</th><th>Result</th><th title="Which prediction was closer to the final margin">Closer</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${shown.map(tr)}</tbody></table></div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Rank by week"
{
  const key = trendBy === "Resume" && hasResume ? "rrk" : "prk"
  const color = trendBy === "Resume" ? hue.resume : hue.power
  const all = trendConf === "all"
  const top = new Set(fbs.filter(d => all ? d[key] <= 25 : inConf(d, trendConf)).map(d => d.id))
  top.add(trendTeam)
  // Top 25 view: ranks beyond 40 break the line instead of piling up at the bottom edge
  const hist0 = R.filter(d => d.s === season && d.tier === 1 && d.w >= 1 && d.w <= snap.w && top.has(d.id))
  const yMax = all ? 40 : Math.max(26, d3.max(hist0, d => d[key]) + 2)
  const hist = hist0.map(d => ({ ...d, [key]: d[key] <= yMax ? d[key] : NaN }))
  const labels = new Map(seasonSnaps.map(d => [d.w, d.label.replace("Week ", "")]))
  const lastW = d3.max(hist, d => d.w)
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 620, marginRight: width < 600 ? 62 : 130, marginLeft: 40,
    x: { label: null, ticks: [...new Set(hist.map(d => d.w))], tickFormat: w => labels.get(w) === "Postseason" ? "Post" : labels.get(w) },
    y: { reverse: true, domain: [1, yMax], label: "Rank", grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.line(hist, { x: "w", y: key, z: "id", stroke: color, strokeOpacity: 0.28, strokeWidth: 1.5, curve: "monotone-x" }),
      Plot.line(R.filter(d => d.s === season && d.id === trendTeam && d.w >= 1 && d.w <= snap.w), { x: "w", y: key, stroke: color, strokeWidth: 3.5, curve: "monotone-x" }),
      Plot.dot(R.filter(d => d.s === season && d.id === trendTeam && d.w >= 1 && d.w <= snap.w), { x: "w", y: key, fill: color, r: 4.5, stroke: "var(--card)", strokeWidth: 1.5 }),
      Plot.dot(hist.filter(d => d.w === lastW), { x: "w", y: key, fill: color, r: 3.5 }),
      Plot.text(hist.filter(d => d.w === lastW), { x: "w", y: key, text: d => width < 600 ? `${d[key]} ${TEAMS.get(d.id)?.abbr ?? d.team}` : `${d[key]}. ${d.team}`, dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fill: "currentColor", fontSize: width < 600 ? 10 : 11 }),
      Plot.tip(hist, Plot.pointer({ x: "w", y: key, title: d => `${d.team}\n${trendBy} #${d[key]} after ${labels.get(d.w)}\n${d.wins}–${d.losses}` }))
    ]
  })
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Earned vs. strength"
{
  const groups = ["Power", "Group", "Independent"].filter(g => fbs.some(d => d.grp === g))
  const on = d => inConf(d, rvpConf)
  const hi = fbs.filter(on)
  const lab = rvpConf === "all" ? fbs.filter(d => d.rrk <= 5 || d.prk <= 5)
    : hi.length <= 20 ? hi : hi.filter(d => d.rrk <= 12 || d.prk <= 12)
  const byGroup = rvpColor === "Conference group"
  const fill = d => byGroup ? d.grp : d.rrk <= cfg.benchmark_rank ? "Top 12" : "Other"
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 560, grid: true, inset: 10,
    x: { label: "Power rating (points vs. average FBS team) →" },
    y: { label: `↑ Wins above #${cfg.benchmark_rank} team (WAB)` },
    color: byGroup
      ? { domain: groups, range: groups.map(g => ({ Power: "var(--g1)", Group: "var(--g2)", Independent: "var(--g3)" })[g]),
          tickFormat: grpName, legend: true }
      : { domain: ["Top 12", "Other"], range: [hue.resume, "var(--ink-3)"], legend: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.5, strokeDasharray: "4,3" }),
      Plot.text([{ x: d3.min(fbs, d => d.pw), y: 0 }], { x: "x", y: "y", text: () => `#${cfg.benchmark_rank}-team benchmark`, dy: -8, fill: "currentColor", fillOpacity: 0.7, fontSize: 11, textAnchor: "start" }),
      Plot.dot(fbs.filter(d => !on(d)), { x: "pw", y: "wab", r: 4.5, fill: fill, fillOpacity: 0.15 }),
      Plot.dot(hi, { x: "pw", y: "wab", r: 5.5, fill: fill, fillOpacity: 0.9, stroke: "var(--card)", strokeWidth: 1.5 }),
      ...placeLabels(lab, "pw", "wab", fbs, width < 600 ? width - 60 : width * 0.55, 500)
        .map(([rows, o]) => Plot.text(rows, { x: "pw", y: "wab", text: "team", fontSize: 11, fill: "currentColor", ...o })),
      Plot.tip(fbs, Plot.pointer({ x: "pw", y: "wab", title: d => `${d.team} (${d.wins}–${d.losses})\n${d.conf} · ${grpName(d.grp)}\nResume #${d.rrk} · WAB ${fmtSigned(d.wab, 2)}\nPower #${d.prk} · ${fmtSigned(d.pw)} pts` }))
    ]
  })
}

```

```{ojs}
viewof pollShow = Inputs.radio(["Top 25", "All"], { value: "Top 25", label: "Show" })
```

## Row {.flow}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
pollStats = {
  const spearman = (rows, k1, k2) => {
    const r = rows.filter(d => d[k1] != null && d[k2] != null)
    if (r.length < 8) return null
    const rk = (arr, k) => { const s = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a[k] - b[k]); return new Map(s.map((d, i) => [d.id, i + 1])) }
    const a = rk(r, k1), b = rk(r, k2), n = r.length
    return 1 - 6 * d3.sum(r, d => (a.get(d.id) - b.get(d.id)) ** 2) / (n * (n * n - 1))
  }
  const overlap = (k1, k2) => fbs.filter(d => d[k1] != null && d[k1] <= 25 && d[k2] != null && d[k2] <= 25).length
  return { apRes: spearman(fbs, "ap", "rrk"), apPow: spearman(fbs, "ap", "prk"), resCol: spearman(fbs, "rrk", "colley"),
           ovRes: overlap("ap", "rrk"), ovPow: overlap("ap", "prk"), hasAP: fbs.some(d => d.ap != null) }
}
```

```{ojs}
htl.html`<div class="tiles">
  <div class="tile resume"><div class="label">AP top 25 ∩ Resume top 25</div><div class="value">${pollStats.hasAP ? `${pollStats.ovRes} / 25` : "No poll"}</div>
    <div class="sub">Rank correlation among AP teams: ${pollStats.apRes == null ? "–" : pollStats.apRes.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
  <div class="tile power"><div class="label">AP top 25 ∩ Power top 25</div><div class="value">${pollStats.hasAP ? `${pollStats.ovPow} / 25` : "No poll"}</div>
    <div class="sub">Rank correlation among AP teams: ${pollStats.apPow == null ? "–" : pollStats.apPow.toFixed(2)}</div></div>
  <div class="tile"><div class="label">Resume vs. Colley (record only)</div><div class="value">${pollStats.resCol == null ? "–" : pollStats.resCol.toFixed(2)}</div>
    <div class="sub">Spearman, all FBS</div></div></div>`
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Rankings compared"
{
  const systems = [
    { key: "rrk", label: "Resume", title: "Bayesian resume rank (WAB)" },
    { key: "sor_rk", label: "SOR", title: "Strength of record: chance the #" + cfg.benchmark_rank + " team matches this record (lower = harder)" },
    { key: "prk", label: "Power", title: "Bayesian power rank" },
    { key: "ap", label: "AP", title: "AP Top 25" },
    { key: "cbs", label: "CBS", title: "CBS Sports 138 (ranks every FBS team; top 25 only in weeks without a full capture)" },
    { key: "coaches", label: "Coaches", title: "Coaches Poll" },
    { key: "cfp", label: "CFP", title: "College Football Playoff committee" },
    { key: "colley", label: "Colley", title: "Colley matrix (record only)" }
  ].filter(s => s.key !== "cfp" || fbs.some(d => d.cfp != null))
  const sys = systems.find(s => s.label === pollSort) ?? systems[0]
  const poll = ["ap", "coaches", "cfp", "cbs"].includes(sys.key)
  const rows = fbs.filter(d => inConf(d, pollConf))
    .filter(d => pollShow === "All" || (d[sys.key] != null && d[sys.key] <= 25))
    .sort((a, b) => (a[sys.key] ?? 999) - (b[sys.key] ?? 999) || a.rrk - b.rrk)
  const cell = (d, s) => {
    const v = d[s.key]
    const text = v == null ? htl.html`<span class="muted">–</span>` : ["ap", "coaches", "cfp", "cbs"].includes(s.key) ? htl.html`<span class="pill">${v}</span>` : v
    return htl.html`<td class="num" style=${s.key === sys.key ? { fontWeight: 700, background: "var(--tint)" } : {}}>${text}</td>`
  }
  return htl.html`<p class="explain">Sorted by <strong>${sys.title}</strong>${poll ? "; unranked teams follow in Resume order" : ""}.
  Every column uses the same games: polls are those released after the selected week.</p>
  <div class="table-wrap"><table class="cfb-table">
  <thead><tr><th class="num rank">#</th><th class="team">Team</th><th class="num hide-xs">Record</th>${systems.map(s => htl.html`<th class="num" title=${s.title} style=${s.key === sys.key ? { color: "var(--ink)" } : {}}>${s.label}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
  <tbody>${rows.map((d, i) => htl.html`<tr class="clickable" onclick=${() => goToTeam(d.id)}>
    <td class="rank num">${i + 1}</td><td class="team">${teamCell(d.id, d.team, d.conf, `${d.wins}–${d.losses}`)}</td><td class="num hide-xs">${d.wins}–${d.losses}</td>
    ${systems.map(s => cell(d, s))}</tr>`)}</tbody></table></div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof raceTeam = {

}
```

```{ojs}
  <strong>Order</strong> is a team's typical place among its conference's bowl teams outside the CFP, by final resume:
  roughly the order in which the conference's bowl tie-ins pick.</p>
  <div class="table-wrap"><table class="cfb-table"><thead><tr><th class="team">Team</th><th class="num">Proj. W</th><th>Bowl-eligible</th>
    <th class="num" title="Median place among the conference's bowl teams outside the CFP">Order</th><th class="num" title="Bowl-eligible and outside the CFP">Non-CFP bowl</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>${rows.map(d => htl.html`<tr class="clickable" onclick=${() => goToTeam(d.id)}>
    <td class="team">${teamCell(d.id, d.team, d.conf)}</td><td class="num">${d.xw.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${pbar(d.p_bowl, "var(--power)")}</td>
    <td class="num">${d.pick == null || d.conf === "FBS Independents" ? "–" : `#${d.pick}`}</td><td class="num">${fmtPct(d.p_pick)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table></div>`
}
```

# Method

## Row {height="55%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

::: {.card .method-card title="How it works"}
**Power** is a Bayesian model fit to every game since the start of the season (FBS, FCS and
lower-division opponents). Each team has a strength, in points, that can drift from week to
week; how fast is estimated from the data. Each game informs it twice: the regulation scoreboard
margin, and an efficiency margin (net expected points added per play, garbage time removed).
The model learns how much to trust each and accounts for their correlation within a game.
A second part of the model does the same for game totals, which splits strength into
**offence** and **defence** and gives projected scores. Teams share information within their
conference and division. The preseason starting point combines the final ratings of the last
two seasons with roster information (the share of last season's production that returns, and
the 247Sports talent composite), weighted by amounts estimated from past seasons. Home field is
estimated each season.

**Resume** asks what a playoff-bubble team, the #12 FBS team by Power, would have done with the
same schedule. Each win adds 1 − P(bubble team wins that game). Each loss subtracts P(bubble team
wins). Opponent strength and venue come from the Power model, so beating a good team on the road
is worth the most. The resume counts only wins and losses; margin feeds Power. All ranks
come with 80% intervals over the model's uncertainty.

**Colley** is shown as a record-only reference; **AP/CFP** ranks are the polls released
after the same games.

**Conference** and **Postseason** play out the rest of the live season thousands of times from
the latest ratings: conference standings and title games, bowl eligibility, and a CFP field picked
by final resume.
:::

### Column {width="50%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Out-of-sample accuracy (predicted before kickoff)"
{
  const rows = transpose(bt_overall)
  return htl.html`<p class="explain">Every game is predicted by the model fitted through the <em>previous</em> week, then compared with the result and the closing line.</p>
  <div class="table-wrap"><table class="cfb-table compact"><thead><tr><th>Games</th><th class="num">n</th><th class="num">MAE</th><th class="num">Vegas MAE</th><th class="num">Accuracy</th><th class="num">Brier</th><th class="num">ATS</th><th class="num" title="Mean absolute error of the projected total (model vs. closing over/under)">Total MAE</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>${rows.map(d => htl.html`<tr><td>${d.scope}</td><td class="num">${d.games.toLocaleString()}</td><td class="num">${d.mae.toFixed(1)}</td>
    <td class="num">${d.mae_vegas == null ? "–" : d.mae_vegas.toFixed(1)}<div class="muted" style="font-size:0.75rem">model ${d.mae_model_lined?.toFixed(1) ?? "–"}</div></td>
    <td class="num">${fmtPct(d.accuracy)}</td><td class="num">${d.brier.toFixed(3)}</td><td class="num">${d.ats_win_rate == null ? "–" : (d.ats_win_rate * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"}</td>
    <td class="num">${d.mae_total_model_ou == null ? "–" : htl.html`${d.mae_total_model_ou.toFixed(1)}<div class="muted" style="font-size:0.75rem">O/U ${d.mae_total_vegas?.toFixed(1) ?? "–"}</div>`}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table></div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  height: 300, grid: true, x: { domain: [0, 1], label: "Predicted home win probability →", tickFormat: "%" }, y: { domain: [0, 1], label: "↑ Actual", tickFormat: "%" },
  marks: [
    Plot.line([[0, 0], [1, 1]], { stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.4, strokeDasharray: "4,3" }),
    Plot.line(transpose(bt_cal), { x: "pred", y: "obs", stroke: hue.power, strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.dot(transpose(bt_cal), { x: "pred", y: "obs", r: d => Math.sqrt(d.n) / 3, fill: hue.power, stroke: "var(--card)" }),
    Plot.tip(transpose(bt_cal), Plot.pointer({ x: "pred", y: "obs", title: d => `Predicted ${fmtPct(d.pred)} · actual ${fmtPct(d.obs)} · ${d.n} games` }))
  ]
})
```
